translation: Snoubord uchib, tushdan keyin dumbamni sovuqda qoldirdim.

example: Skating made Dad hold the wall very lovingly.
translation: Konkida uchish dadamni devorni mehr bilan ushlashga majbur qildi.

example: Surfing taught me how salty the sea is.
translation: Syorfing menga dengiz qanchalik sho‘r ekanini o‘rgatdi.

example: Diving introduced me to some very curious fish.
translation: Suv ostiga sho‘ng‘ish meni juda qiziquvchan baliqlar bilan tanishtirdi.

example: Sailing is easier when the wind agrees.
translation: Shamol rozi bo‘lsa, yelkanli qayiqda suzish osonroq.

example: At archery, my first arrow surprised the grass.
translation: Kamondan otishda birinchi o‘qim maysani hayron qoldirdi.

example: During yoga, my cat copies me more easily.
translation: Yoga paytida mushugim harakatlarimni osonroq takrorlaydi.

example: Our team shares one ball and many opinions.
translation: Jamoamiz bitta to‘p va ko‘p fikrni bo‘lishadi.

example: Our smallest player has the loudest celebration.
translation: Eng kichik o‘yinchimiz eng baland ovozda nishonlaydi.

example: The athlete finished before I opened my water.
translation: Sportchi suvimni ochishimdan oldin marraga yetdi.

example: Our goalkeeper caught the ball and a leaf.
translation: Darvozabonimiz to‘p bilan birga bargni ham tutdi.

example: The referee ran more than some players.
translation: Hakam ayrim o‘yinchilardan ko‘proq yugurdi.

example: The match ended before Dad found his glasses.
translation: Dadam ko‘zoynagini topmasidan o‘yin tugadi.

example: Our tournament included a very serious biscuit break.
translation: Turnirimizda juda jiddiy pechenye tanaffusi bo‘ldi.

example: The champion still asks Mum to find his socks.
translation: Chempion hali ham onasidan paypoqlarini topishni so‘raydi.

example: The winner received a cup bigger than her head.
translation: G‘olib boshidan katta kubok oldi.

example: My medal looks excellent with my pyjamas.
translation: Medalim pijamam bilan juda yaxshi ko‘rinadi.

example: The trophy needs its own seat in the car.
translation: Kubokka mashinada alohida o‘rindiq kerak.

example: Dad forgot the score but remembered every snack.
translation: Dadam hisobni unutdi, lekin har bir yegulikni esladi.

example: My first goal surprised both teams.
translation: Birinchi golim ikkala jamoani ham hayron qoldirdi.

example: I won one point and celebrated for five minutes.
translation: Bir ochko yutib, besh daqiqa nishonladim.

example: The ball bounced straight into the teacher's bag.
translation: To‘p sakrab, to‘g‘ri o‘qituvchining sumkasiga tushdi.

example: My racket is ready; my legs are not.
translation: Raketkam tayyor, oyoqlarim esa yo‘q.

example: The net caught more leaves than balls today.
translation: Bugun to‘r to‘pdan ko‘ra ko‘proq barg tutdi.

example: My helmet makes my head look like a mushroom.
translation: Dubulg‘am boshimni qo‘ziqoringa o‘xshatadi.

example: The whistle ended our dreams of another goal.
translation: Hushtak yana gol urish orzuyimizni tugatdi.

example: The stadium cheered louder than our school bell.
translation: Stadion maktab qo‘ng‘irog‘imizdan balandroq hayqirdi.

example: A duck visited the pitch during our match.
translation: O‘yinimiz vaqtida maydonga o‘rdak keldi.

example: The tennis court became a puddle after lunch.
translation: Tushlikdan keyin tennis maydoni ko‘lmakka aylandi.

example: At the gym, I lift more water than weights.
translation: Sport zalida og‘irlikdan ko‘ra ko‘proq suv ko‘taraman.

example: Our race to the tree ended at the bakery.
translation: Daraxtgacha poygamiz nonvoyxonada tugadi.

meaning: yo‘lak yoki hovuz bo‘ylab bir aylanish
example: One lap was enough to silence my boasting.
translation: Bir aylanish maqtanishimni to‘xtatishga yetdi.

example: Our adventure began with a very wrong turn.
translation: Sarguzashtimiz juda noto‘g‘ri burilishdan boshlandi.

example: Hiking makes ordinary bread taste wonderful.
translation: Tabiatda uzoq yurish oddiy nonni ham ajoyib mazali qiladi.

example: Camping taught us to respect indoor toilets.
translation: Chodirda dam olish uydagi hojatxonaning qadrini o‘rgatdi.

example: Our tent looked larger on the packet.
translation: Chodirimiz qadoqda kattaroq ko‘ringan edi.

example: My sleeping bag turned me into a warm sausage.
translation: Uyqu qopim meni issiq kolbasaga aylantirdi.

example: We told stories beside the campfire until bedtime.
translation: Uxlash vaqtigacha gulxan yonida hikoyalar aytdik.

example: Our picnic attracted three dogs and one uncle.
translation: Sayr dasturxonimiz uchta it va bir amakini jalb qildi.

meaning: ochiq olovda taom pishirib dam olish
example: Dad's barbecue produced more smoke than dinner.
translation: Dadamning ochiq olovda ovqat pishirishi taomdan ko‘proq tutun chiqardi.

example: The trail ended beside a very welcome café.
translation: Sayr yo‘li juda kerakli kafe yonida tugadi.

example: This path is wide enough for one hungry tourist.
translation: Bu so‘qmoqqa bitta och sayyoh sig‘adi.

example: The footpath took us past suspicious sheep.
translation: Piyoda yo‘li bizni shubha bilan qarayotgan qo‘ylar yonidan olib o‘tdi.

example: We climb slowly to protect our chocolate biscuits.
translation: Shokoladli pechenyelarimizni asrash uchun sekin chiqamiz.

example: Jump over the puddle, not into my lunch.
translation: Ko‘lmakdan sakrab o‘ting, tushligimning ichiga emas.

example: I jog until the bakery smell stops me.
translation: Nonvoyxona hidi to‘xtatguncha sekin yuguraman.

example: Stretch your legs before our ambitious ten-minute hike.
translation: Katta niyat bilan boshlayotgan o‘n daqiqalik sayrimizdan oldin oyoq mushaklaringizni cho‘zing.

example: I balance on one foot while finding my sock.
translation: Paypog‘imni qidirib, bir oyoqda muvozanat saqlayman.

example: Throw the ball away from the birthday cake.
translation: To‘pni tug‘ilgan kun tortidan uzoqroqqa oting.

example: Catch the ball before it catches your lunch.
translation: To‘p tushligingizga tegmasidan uni tuting.

example: Kick the ball gently near Grandma's flowers.
translation: Buvimning gullari yonida to‘pni sekin teping.

example: The ball can bounce higher than my little cousin.
translation: To‘p kichik amakivachchamdan balandroq sapchiy oladi.

example: We warm up before our very short run.
translation: Juda qisqa yugurishimizdan oldin badan qizdiramiz.

example: We set off early and forgot the tent.
translation: Erta yo‘lga chiqib, chodirni unutdik.

example: We get lost whenever Dad says he knows.
translation: Dadam yo‘lni bilaman deganida har safar adashamiz.

example: Fishing gives Grandpa an excuse to sit quietly.
translation: Baliq ovlash bobomga jim o‘tirish uchun bahona beradi.

example: Birdwatching is difficult with my sneezing brother.
translation: Aksirayotgan ukam bilan qush kuzatish qiyin.

example: My leisure time begins when the dishes are clean.
translation: Bo‘sh vaqtim idishlar tozalanganda boshlanadi.

example: I relax best where nobody can find the vacuum.
translation: Hech kim changyutgichni topolmaydigan joyda yaxshi dam olaman.

example: After our holiday, Dad needed a rest.
translation: Ta’tildan keyin dadamga dam kerak bo‘ldi.

example: We had fun even when the kite escaped.
translation: Varrak qochib ketganda ham maza qildik.

example: Eating outdoors means sharing lunch with curious ants.
translation: Ochiq havoda ovqatlanish tushlikni qiziquvchan chumolilar bilan bo‘lishishdir.

example: We played indoors after the rain won.
translation: Yomg‘ir yutgach, bino ichida o‘ynadik.

example: Dad tried to sunbathe under an enormous umbrella.
translation: Dadam ulkan soyabon ostida quyoshga toblanmoqchi bo‘ldi.

example: We snorkel to meet fish without knocking.
translation: Baliqlar bilan eshik taqillatmay uchrashish uchun naycha bilan suzamiz.

example: My skateboard moves faster when I fall off.
translation: Skeytbordim men yiqilganda tezroq yuradi.

example: The kite preferred the tree to the sky.
translation: Varrak osmondan ko‘ra daraxtni afzal ko‘rdi.

example: Grandma chose the swing before the children arrived.
translation: Buvim bolalar kelmasidan arg‘imchoqni tanladi.

example: The slide made my little cousin's hair stand up.
translation: Sirpanib tushganda kichik amakivachchamning sochi tik bo‘ldi.

example: The seesaw works better without Dad on one end.
translation: Bir uchida dadam bo‘lmasa, arg‘imchoq yaxshiroq ishlaydi.

example: Our playground has no room for adult worries.
translation: O‘yin maydonchamizda kattalarning tashvishlariga joy yo‘q.

example: The amusement park made Dad scream like a child.
translation: Attraksionlar bog‘ida dadam boladek qichqirdi.

example: This theme park has dinosaurs selling ice cream.
translation: Bu mavzuli bog‘da dinozavrlar muzqaymoq sotadi.

example: We left the funfair with an enormous teddy.
translation: Attraksionlar saylidan ulkan o‘yinchoq ayiq bilan qaytdik.

example: The roller coaster rearranged my carefully combed hair.
translation: Tezkor attraksion tartibli taralgan sochimni qayta turmakladi.

example: The Ferris wheel showed us everyone's colourful hats.
translation: Charxpalak bizga hammaning rang-barang shlyapalarini ko‘rsatdi.

example: Our sandcastle had a garage but no roof.
translation: Qum qal’amizda garaj bor edi, lekin tom yo‘q edi.

example: Getting into the hammock was my daily exercise.
translation: Osma belanchakka chiqish kunlik mashqim bo‘ldi.

example: The frisbee landed on our sleeping uncle.
translation: Uloqtirilgan disk uxlayotgan amakimiz ustiga tushdi.

example: The paddling pool was perfect for Dad's tired feet.
translation: Bolalar hovuzi dadamning charchagan oyoqlariga ayni muddao edi.

example: The deckchair folded before I finished sitting down.
translation: O‘tirib bo‘lmasimdan yig‘ma kursi yig‘ilib qoldi.

example: The waterslide delivered me without my brave expression.
translation: Suvli attraksiondan tushganda yuzimdagi jasorat yo‘qolgan edi.
